rows.text: Royal Order A/15 dated 19/2/1430 AH constitutes the Shura Council of the Chairman and named members for four Hijri years beginning when the current council's term (the council formed by Royal Order A/30 of 2/3/1426 AH) ends, and lists 'الشيخ الدكتور / عبدالله بن محمد بن إبراهيم آل الشيخ ( رئيس مجلس الشورى )' first.
